name: docsmith
description: Author polished, print-ready PDFs from a source document by composing hand-written JSX with the @docsmith/docsmith component library — styled to vanilla ShadCN tokens (light/dark), rendered via @react-pdf/renderer, with mermaid diagrams as real vector cards and nothing running off the page. Ships the docsmith:docsmith builder skill and the docsmith:feature-doc feature/architecture-doc skill. Use when making a designed/branded PDF, exporting a README or doc to PDF, rendering a doc whose mermaid diagrams must appear as real diagrams, or writing up a feature/module as a polished architecture handoff.
